content.comment_body: Hello everyone, sorry for writing in Portuguese — my English isn't great, so I'll use a translator to discuss my issue. I have an old program that needed updating. Since then, a message saying 'NO MESSAGE FOR CURRENT CHARSET' appears on the [product_name] operator display. I tried putting the device in STOP and then START, but it didn't resolve the issue. Re-downloading the program temporarily fixes it, but after some time, the error message returns.
Here is a picture showing the error.

Hi [user_name], this forum uses English, so please write your future posts in English. Thanks. You may find helpful information in this entry: 'HELP! [product_name] Operator Display: No message for current charset.'

Sorry, I'll try using Google Translate for these conversations. The issue is with an old program that needs updating. After the update, the display shows 'NO MESSAGE FOR THE CURRENT CHARSET.' Restarting the device doesn't solve it. Sending the program again works for a while, but the error later reappears.

It's not clear which [product_name] model you have. If you are using the latest version ([version_no], [article_no]), check the message text settings in the file properties. There, you can choose if M27 is reserved for changing character sets or for other functions. [IMAGE]
Good afternoon, I'm using an older [product_name] version ([article_no]) as shown in the program I attached.
I'm sorry, but I can't assist further in this case. I do not have the TD device, only a TDE.

analysis.insight_summary: The user faces a recurring error message on an older [product_name] setup after updating the program. Reinstalling the program temporarily resolves the issue, but the error returns after some time. Troubleshooting is hampered by incomplete details about the hardware version, making it difficult for others to assist effectively.
analysis.user_expectations: The user seeks reliable performance from the [product_name] operator device following a program update and hopes for clear instructions about message and character set settings, without ongoing error messages.
